english.note: Use this technical noun for an aircraft’s level, constant-speed cruising phase.

examples.english: After the aircraft enters the cruise phase, the captain tells everyone they may unfasten their seat belts.
examples.traditional: 飛機進入巡航階段後，機長先通知大家可以解開安全帶。
